name: package-manager-development
description: Package Manager Development: version schemes and constraints, manifests, dependency resolution (backtracking, SAT, PubGrub, MVS), lockfiles and reproducibility, registry design, cache/layout/linking (flat, nested, content-addressed, PnP), publishing and authentication (trusted publishing, OIDC, provenance, Sigstore, SLSA), supply-chain attacks and defenses, lifecycle scripts, workspaces and monorepos, performance, UX, the cross-ecosystem comparison (npm, pip/uv, Cargo, Go modules, Maven, NuGet, apt/dnf, Nix), and governance.
